text:
maria: CI red on main, decrypt step failing for several jobs — anyone else?
devon: yep seeing same across macos/linux runners, failure during secrets fetch
shaun: ping @maria for build url so I can look
maria: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/2345 — log shows KMS/auth error
maria: ```
Error: env decryption failed
Status: 403 PermissionDenied
cloudkms.googleapis.com: PermissionDenied: Request had insufficient authentication scopes
caused by: oauth2: cannot fetch token: 401 Unauthorized
```
priya: hmmm we rotated keys / bindings last night as part of scheduled maintenance — maybe a binding got dropped
infra-bot: IAM change detected: policy updated on projects/redwood-ci at 1987654200 by infra-admin (rotation: kms-key-2026)
devon: that lines up. my guess: gha-runner service account not in cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter binding after apply
shaun: can someone try a manual rerun (with fresh runner) to see if it's ephemeral cache vs config? I can kick it off, but prefer bisect if rerun still fails
maria: bisect please — failures started after commit 8f9a3 -> 8f9a4
priya: @devon can you check the key's IAM members quickly? I can open infra PR if it's a terraform drift
devon: checking... yep, gha-runner@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com is missing from roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on tests/key-1
shaun: temporary workaround: grant specific binding back to gha-runner for that key to unblock CI: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-ci/locations/global/keyRings/test/cryptoKeys/key-1 --member=serviceAccount:gha-runner@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`
maria: please scope to the test key only, do not add org-wide role
priya: I'm opening a terraform PR to re-add binding and fix drift — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/456
devon: shaun started a rerun (build 2345.2)
buildbot: rebuild queued: 2345.2 (trigger: shaun)
maria: thx. reminder: runners cache short-lived tokens (ttl=1h) — if rotation happened mid-run, stale creds can cause intermittent 401/403s
shaun: if rerun still fails we'll bisect across commits between 8f9a3..8f9a7, assigning @devon to run bisect
priya: added a note to PR to add a cache-purge step for gha-runner post-rotation to avoid the stale-token window
maria: rerun looks green so far in the matrix — one flaky job requeued and passed
devon: confirmed: 2345.2 succeeded, looks unblocked. still merging infra PR so we don't regress
priya: follow-up todo: run an org-wide check for other keys that lost bindings during rotation (script in PR)
shaun: will review the infra PR and schedule a TF apply in a low-traffic window
maria: leaving a short incident blurb in #incidents after PR merges
devon: great catch everyone — special thanks to @priya for the quick PR and @shaun for the rerun
priya: :thumbsup:
shaun: closing this thread once PR is merged and TF apply done
maria: thanks team, back to normal
